{{Quote|After cross-checking numerous accounts of your recent exploits with a detailed report provided by Risha Drayen, the Galactic Finders Guild is pleased to formally record your name as the locator of Nok Drayen's lost fortune, aka Missing Wealth Collection #3263827.|Hrenn Indiru's letter to the [[Voidhound]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Galactic Finders Guild''' was a treasure hunters' guild active in the years before and during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The guild tracked various missing and found valuables, keeping official records of the finds and adding a layer of bureaucracy to the competitive nature of treasure hunting. [[Hrenn Indiru]] held the post of a Chief Secretary as of [[3643 BBY]].
